note: Zoom on the chart table in the middle of the B25 map room (R_abs_space_01): an unrolled sea chart with brass dividers, compass and rulers. Feminine LEFT: frog striking a pose with a posy on its spot (position); blue-and-white vase on a heavy stone base (base); ladybird dancing between the points of the open dividers (distance); mouse putting down a wedge of cheese on one exact spot (mise). Masculine RIGHT: goat and sheep tugging one rope in opposite directions (contraire); three ducklings, the fluffy one at the rear (arrière); snail snug within a ring of sand (sein, au sein de = within). No painted exit: the strip Back returns to the map room. Sign on the table edge. Painted 2026-10-22 (track s08p3).
